{{Quote|Bak! It's a &hellip; Blast him, moron! The frammin' Crotok's got a &hellip;|[[Druug]] of ''Profit'', immediately after the destruction of ''Trust Me''|<ref name="Journal5" />}}
'''''Trust Me''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that formed a part of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang that operated out of [[Darknon Station]]. At one point by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it and two other vessels of the gang laid an [[Ambush near Darknon Station|ambush]] on the [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] ''[[Kizbon's Box]]''; however, the latter instead swiftly destroyed all of the pirate ships.

==Description==
''Trust Me'' was an [[Weapon/Legends|armed]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that had the capability to emit a quick binary pulse for communication purposes.<ref name="Journal5" />

==History==
{{Quote|Harvest time! Remember, our mark's got a stripped-down discontinued bucket with external cargo pods. Feel free to blaze away at the cockpit section, but leave the aft free for bounty.|Larken, to the crews of ''Trust Me'' and ''Profit''|<ref name="Journal5" />}}
[[File:Helix-AJ5.png|thumb|right|300px|''Trust Me'' and its fellow pirate starships laid an ambush on the ''Helix''-class light interceptor ''Kizbon's Box'' (a ''Helix''-class vessel pictured).]]
The crew of ''Trust Me'' were part of<ref name="Journal5" /> a pirate gang based on [[Darknon Station]],<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> a [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="Journal5" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Itani system/Legends|Itani system]]</ref> At one point by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="Platt" /> the pirates laid an [[Ambush near Darknon Station|ambush]] on the [[Unidentified pilot (Kizbon's Box)|pilot]] of the [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] ''[[Kizbon's Box]]'' while it was traveling to Darknon Station. Along with two other starships, the ''[[Pillage]]''&mdash;[[Captain/Legends|captained]] by<ref name="Journal5" /> the leader of the gang,<ref name="Platt" /> [[Larken]]&mdash;and [[Profit (pirate ship)|''Profit'']], ''Trust Me'' lay in wait while enveloped by a [[Magnetic storm/Legends|magnetic storm]] that shielded them from detection by shipboard [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], with the ''Pillage'' situated twenty thousand [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] behind the other vessels in order to cut off any potential escape by the ''Kizbon's Box''.<ref name="Journal5" />

After their target entered [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] in the vicinity of Darknon Station, ''Trust Me'', according to a pre-arranged battle plan, used a rapid binary pulse to signal to the other pirate ships the arrival of the optimal time to launch their ambush. At that point, Larken gave his fellow crews the command to commence their attack and then watched the other two ships ignite their [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] through the ''Pillage''{{'s}} [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]].  When ''Trust Me'' and ''Profit'' subsequently closed to weapons range, the ''Kizbon's Box'', the armament of which exceeded the pirates' expectations, suddently launched [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] toward ''Trust Me'', instantly destroying the vessel. The destruction of ''Trust Me'' threw the rest of the pirate gang in panic, and they were also soon obliterated by the ''Kizbon's Box''.<ref name="Journal5" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Trust Me'' appeared in "Kizbon's Box," a short companion narrative included in "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]," a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article authored by [[Stephen Luminati]] and published in the [[February]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal5" />
